summary: Expose body and bodyUsed as stream-backed state, distinguishing null body, locked stream, and disturbed stream.

semantics.null_body: body is null and bodyUsed false
semantics.bodyUsed: true iff body stream is disturbed
semantics.locked_vs_used: locked alone makes body unusable but does not necessarily mean disturbed/bodyUsed true

tests.name: reading marks used
tests.input: const r=new Response("x"); const reader=r.body.getReader(); await reader.read(); console.log(r.bodyUsed); reader.releaseLock();
